7. With 48 red sand gathered, we craft 4 red sandstone slabs.
8. Now that we have 4 red sandstone slabs, we need to cut each of them into cut red sandstone to make the cut red sandstone slabs.
9. Each red sandstone slab needs to be crafted into 4 cut red sandstone pieces.
10. So, for 4 red sandstone slabs, we need 16 cut red sandstone pieces in total.
11. To get 16 cut red sandstone pieces, we need 16 cut red sandstone slabs.

13. Since we already know we need 48 red sand to craft 12 red sandstone slabs, which we can use to craft 4 red sandstone slabs, we can use those 4 red sandstone slabs to craft 16 cut red sandstone pieces.
14. Thus, we craft the 4 red sandstone slabs first, which gives us enough red sand to craft 16 cut red sandstone pieces.
15. Finally, we craft the 16 cut red sandstone pieces into 6 cut red sandstone slabs.
